notes: Keep strong work as an example: press ☆ Example on an answer in Quick mark (or E), or pick Use as an example in the ⋯ beside a student’s name for a whole paper or part of a page. Names are covered, and your marks and the score stay off unless you switch them on. It is always optional.
The Examples tab on an assignment, and Examples in the sidebar for every class, have Show to the class, Copy picture, Download and Download as a sheet.
Examples go to your linked folder and into the take-home file with the rest of your work.
